limits: Disposable Start and two diagnostic checkpoints replace normal navigation.
Exact marked candidate UI blocks and exact baseline blocks run in the native QSP engine and their printed $maintxt HTML is checked.
The complete generated EXEC href is captured and executed; only the existing $msg formatter is instrumented to record its notice instead of opening a modal.
The actual private-room bridge enters and leaves the actor proxy; saves are primed as assignments without loading or writing a save.
Checks establish generated HTML, action behavior and source parity; they do not visually assess full-screen CSS placement or tooltip positioning.
